name: authority-disguise-attack
trigger: When the prompt cites authoritative sources or uses legal/technical jargon to frame a request for advice or guidance.
strategy: The attack disguises harmful intent by using authoritative references and detailed context to elevate the query's perceived legitimacy and complexity, making it appear as a request for professional or educational guidance.
guidance: Identify and strip away the authoritative references and detailed context to uncover the underlying harmful intent; focus on the core request or action being disguised.
